question.problem: It takes $7$ hours for a snail to crawl $210$ centimeters, moving at a constant pace. Find the distance this snail covers in $4$ hours.
question.worked_solution:
Speed is a special unit rate applied to moving objects. It is defined as *the distance traveled per unit of time*:

$$
\text{speed}=\frac{\text{distance}}{\text{time}}
$$

To find the speed in centimeters per hour, we divide the number of centimeters $210,$ by the number of hours, $7.$ This gives,

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{210}{7} & =210÷7 \\  & =30.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the speed of the snail is $30$ centimeters per hour. 

To find the distance covered in $4$ hours, we multiply the speed by $4.$ This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{distance} & =\text{speed}\times \text{time} \\  & =30\times 4 \\  & =120.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the snail covers $120$ centimeters in $4$ hours.
